**Which regulation?**
e.g., ISO 42001, SEBI AI Governance, ANVISA, TGA, Health Canada

**Which sections need coverage?**
List the specific sections or articles that need validation checks.

**Are you a regulatory consultant or clinical AI team?**

- [ ] Regulatory consultant / compliance officer
- [ ] Clinical AI / healthcare ML engineer

- [ ] Other: ___

**What thresholds or criteria should pass/fail?**
e.g., "sensitivity ≥ 0.70, AUC ≥ 0.80 for diagnostic use cases"

**Additional context**
Any links to the official regulation, guidance docs, or reference implementations.
